_doc: Dashboard view preferences (reversible, UI-only). `hidden_audit_kinds` hides those derived audit kinds (bounty | eval) from the audit dropdown + all-audits list on the main dashboard. This NEVER deletes files, never changes audits/registry.json, and never affects switching — the ACTIVE audit is always shown, and hidden audits remain one click away via the all-audits scope buttons. To restore everything, set hidden_audit_kinds to [].
